input.title: GPT Image-1.5 - Text to Image — input
input.description: Input parameters for the generation task

prompt.description: A text description of the image you want to generate
examples: Create a photorealistic candid photograph of an elderly sailor standing on a small fishing boat.  He has weathered skin with visible wrinkles, pores, and sun texture, and a few faded traditional sailor tattoos on his arms. He is calmly adjusting a net while his dog sits nearby on the deck. Shot like a 35mm film photograph, medium close-up at eye level, using a 50mm lens. The image should feel honest and unposed, with real skin texture, worn materials, and everyday detail. No glamorization, no heavy retouching.

aspect_ratio.description: Width-height ratio of the image, determining its visual form.
